ShortDescription.Value: Turn a junction into a complete interchange in one placement (平改立)

Publish.LongDescription:
**section2change (平改立)** places a whole interchange in one go: pick a type, aim at an existing junction, crossing or road (or empty ground), check the preview, confirm.
**13 interchange types** - Four-way: diamond, single-point, Chinese expressway node, cloverleaf, partial cloverleaf, roundabout, stack, turbine - Three-way: expressway T, trumpet, semi-directional T, directional T - Wye (three roads at about 120°)
**Features** - Upgrade existing junctions: matches roads, levels and angle, removes the old junction and reconnects every leg; roads under bridges with enough clearance are kept - Follows curved roads (radius 150 m or more) and places the interchange on the roads' grade - Lane balance with edge-aligned lane drops, pillars kept clear of roads below, grade and clearance checked before placing - Auto mode (point and confirm) or manual mode (every parameter adjustable); Chinese and English UI - Node mode: select open road endpoints to solve and place cloverleaf, stack, turbine, trumpet, directional T, semi-directional T, wye, compact grid or roundabout; two-way, divided and mixed inputs with bounded approach reconstruction - Colored endpoint feedback, lane matching, smoother curved connections, and cancellable background solving for two-way/mixed stacks
**How to use** 1. Open the tool with the button at the top left or Shift + I 2. Pick a type and hover a junction, a road or empty ground 3. Left-click to pin the preview, check the panel, then Confirm
**Please note** - Placement cannot be undone (the game does not support undo) - save first if in doubt - Works best on flat ground with straight, uniform-grade roads - Trumpet, directional types, stack, turbine and wye support right-hand traffic only - Beta: report problems on GitHub with a screenshot and the mod log (turn on debug logging in the settings first)
**平改立**：一次放下一整座立交。保留自动和手动模式；新增点选开放节点，按实际端点重新求解并确认放置。节点模式支持苜蓿叶、定向、涡轮、喇叭、定向T、半定向T、Y型、井字和环岛，以及双向、双幅和混合道路的有界退接。放置后不能撤销，请先存档；实际道路须满足车道匹配、坡度、净空和游戏原生检查。问题请到 GitHub 附截图和日志反馈。

ChangeLog.Value: 1.0.9-beta: Add node-selected interchange preview and confirmed placement for cloverleaf, stack, turbine, trumpet, directional T, semi-directional T, wye, compact grid and roundabout. Support exact-lane two-way/divided/mixed approaches, bounded reconstruction, curved and mixed-height connections, lane balance and endpoint feedback. Improve stack ramp curvature and short-tail cut selection; solve two-way/mixed stacks in a cancellable background worker. Keep native placement checks and error diagnostics. 2319 automated checks passed for the archived functional baseline; the latest stack test scenes were confirmed by the user.
